subject: Weekly MAP sync: SDK/API integration and close timeline (CloudSpark)
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah@cloudspark.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@cloudspark.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP update + a couple integration clarifications

Vanessa — thanks again for yesterday's demo. Tom and I aligned on the evaluation plan and wanted to confirm a few integration details before our next checkpoint:   

- Auth model: we plan to run in a cloud-to-cloud flow using OAuth + scoped service accounts. We need to confirm any IP allowlists or certificate pins.
- Streaming: we’ll validate streaming tokenization behavior and partial-response handling for our transcripts pipeline.
- SDK: our infra team wants to avoid a direct dependency on the Redwood JS SDK until we confirm compatibility with our sidecar pattern.

Our tentative close timeline is end of August (we're pushing for Aug 31). Can we lock weekly MAP synces on Fridays? Attached is our high-level MAP (see MAP_v1.pptx).

Action: Sarah to collect infra questions; Vanessa to propose owners for SDK/auth/streaming tasks.

--
Sarah Liu
Head of Platform
CloudSpark
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah@cloudspark.com>
Cc: Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@cloudspark.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP update + a couple integration clarifications

Thanks Sarah — Friday synces work for our team. Quick replies below and I added internal owners for the items you called out. See inline:  

- Auth model / IP allowlist: Karthik will own a short doc on allowed connection patterns and produce an allowlist template. (Owner: Karthik Iyer)
- Streaming: Marissa will run an end-to-end stream test with a trimmed transcript sample and report latency/partial-chunk behavior. (Owner: Marissa Cole)
- SDK adoption: Rishi will outline minimum shim for your sidecar pattern so you can start without adding the full JS SDK. (Owner: Rishi Malhotra)

I attached an integration checklist (sdk-integration-checklist.xlsx) with proposed tickets and acceptance criteria. I'll set up a recurring Friday 30-min MAP sync starting 7/16. If Aug 31 is the goal, we need to freeze the eval scenarios by 7/30.

Next steps for Friday: 1) confirm IP allowlist holes, 2) share streaming sample, 3) agree on SDK shim acceptance tests.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP update + a couple integration clarifications

Vanessa — noted. Short status update on owner workstreams:  

- IP allowlist / network patterns (Karthik): drafting the allowlist template and capturing the TLS/cert expectations. Will add a short note on whether mutual TLS is required for Private deployments vs. hosted. Deliverable: allowlist_template.md (stub) by 7/20.
- Streaming test harness (Marissa): have a small harness that can replay transcripts and assert chunk boundaries. Will test the 1-2 minute sample Sarah will provide. Deliverable: streaming_test_report.pdf by 7/23.
- SDK shim (Rishi): prototype a lightweight HTTP shim that matches your sidecar contract; avoids pulling in our full SDK until you’re ready. Deliverable: shim-prototype.zip and README by 7/28.

Risks: If the streaming sample reveals tokenization differences, Marissa may need extra time to tweak chunk assembly logic (risk window +3 business days).

Grace: can you coordinate compute availability on the dedicated cluster for the streaming run?

-Karthik
From: Sarah Liu <sarah@cloudspark.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@cloudspark.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP update + a couple integration clarifications

Thanks — attaching the 90s transcript sample for the streaming run. We prefer Friday synces at 10am PT. For the allowlist: we can provide our egress IPs this week.

Attachments: transcript_90s.txt (text)

Notes: Tom and I reviewed acceptance criteria on the checklist and marked two must-haves: 1) streaming partial-results delivered within 500ms of token emission for 95th percentile; 2) SDK shim supports request/response correlation ids.

-Sarah
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah@cloudspark.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@cloudspark.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP weekly rollup: owners, actions, and near-term timeline

Team — quick rollup from today's MAP sync (10:00am PT). We hit the items we planned for the week; owner commitments below and next milestones toward the Aug 31 close.

Summary of owners & actions (owner — task — due):
- Karthik Iyer — produce allowlist_template.md and note on mTLS differences between Private/Hosted — due 2026-07-20.
- Marissa Cole — run streaming harness against transcript_90s.txt and publish streaming_test_report.pdf — due 2026-07-23. If tokenization mismatch appears, add +/- 3 business days buffer.
- Rishi Malhotra — deliver SDK shim prototype (shim-prototype.zip) with correlation-id support and README — due 2026-07-28.
- Vanessa Ortiz — coordinate Friday MAP invites, liaise with procurement for contract redline window (target redline received by 2026-07-30).
- Grace O'Connor — confirm dedicated cluster slot for streaming test on 7/22-7/24.

Dependencies & risks:
- Streaming perf is the gating risk for go-live in Aug. If the 95th percentile requirement isn't met, we'll evaluate a cached prefix approach (Redwood Optimize) for partial results.
- Procurement needs to get final MSA redline in the last week of July to hit Aug 31 close.

Attachments referenced: MAP_v1.pptx, sdk-integration-checklist.xlsx (see Drive link). HubSpot deal updated with these action items: https://hubspot.example/deal/CS-2026-0419

Please reply only if you need changes to owners/due dates; otherwise I'll keep the Friday cadence and circulate minutes next week.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
